title: Cab Calloway's band
summary: He describes the sidemen in Cab's band.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Yeah. You were mentioning Cab. We haven't said too much about his group. What was his group like during that same 1930's time?

Cab. Cab had, he had some good musicians in the band. But, you know, with his '40 de-40 most of the features, Cab, you know, that he hired, you know, singing, like I said, they had Chu Berry (Unaudible) in there and, oh, Dizzy Gillespie. He was in there. Dizzy was with Cab. And, there are some names that can't come to me now. But, Cozy Cole. I think that was Cab's drummer, I believe. Then, he had Jonah Jones. He had some very good musicians in there. He had a good, he had a good playing band. He had a good band. And the sidemen, they was actually kicking.
Cab comes up here every now and then to do a show.
